head: 5d2ce1e8
gate: Stable HTTP/1 pull body reader with content decoding, HTTP/2 pull nextBody and concurrent stream serving aliases
notes: The HTTP/1 pull BodyReader drives the existing push parser through a bounded FIFO producer. Tests cover a 200 KiB body with 100-continue and keep-alive, chunked trailers, cancellation closing an unread connection, max_body_bytes rejection, non-blocking takeRequest, and Head.streamContentDecoder identity decoding. HTTP/2 ServerDuplexStream.nextBody pulls DATA, retains trailers for requestTrailers, returns null at END_STREAM and exposes streamContentDecoder. HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 concurrent batch aliases are exposed through netz.streaming.
